title: Mixed Event — Time to RE:START! — Episode1 I'll Become an Idol Too!

meta.Episode: Episode1 — I'll Become an Idol Too!
meta.Event Outline: Eager to make MORE MORE JUMP! official, Airi and the others waste no time in searching for an agency to join, but...

rows.Line:
By giving everything we've got to our role,
we're able to pass on those feelings of working hard
                    for tomorrow to our fans.

So no matter how uncertain or tough things get,
   we keep looking forward to stay positive and
make sure to give everyone the smiles they need.

I still remember when I first decided that I wanted to
                    become that sort of idol.

rows.Speaker: Little Airi
rows.Line: Hey! How many times do I have to tell you not to make my sister cry before you get it through your thick skulls?!

rows.Speaker: Lead Bully
rows.Line: Shut up! You sure talk big for a pipsqueak!

rows.Speaker: Neighborhood Bully
rows.Line: Yeah, why don't you take your crybaby sister and get lost!

rows.Speaker: Lead Bully
rows.Line: Hmph! Better run home to mommy while you still can!

rows.Speaker: Little Airi
rows.Line: Who are you calling a pipsqueak...?

rows.Speaker: Little Airi
rows.Line: Apologize right now or we'll see who the crybaby really is!

rows.Speaker: Little Airi
rows.Line:
Ow! Oww! Mom, stop!
Please be more gentle!

rows.Speaker: Airi's Mother
rows.Line:
I am, but you need to hold still!
I can't stop until I'm done disinfecting this.

rows.Speaker: Little Airi
rows.Line: Hrng... Fine...

rows.Speaker: Airi's Mother
rows.Line:
Sometimes I wish you weren't such a tomboy.
Do you always have to go pick fights with boys?

rows.Speaker: Little Airi
rows.Line: But...

rows.Speaker: Airi's Mother
rows.Line: You come with your clothes all dirty and your hair all messed up after I spent so much time on it. And you ate so many daifuku that you started to choke...

rows.Speaker: Little Airi
rows.Line: Wh-What does the last one have to do with anything?!

rows.Speaker: Little Airi
rows.Line:
Besides, I'm fine!
I'm used to getting into fights!

rows.Speaker: Airi's Mother
rows.Line: That's not the point! How can you be proud of that?

rows.Speaker: Little Airi
rows.Line: I-I know but...!

rows.Speaker: Little Airi
rows.Line:
Hm...?
Hey, what's this song?

rows.Speaker: Airi's Mother
rows.Line:
Hm? Oh, that's just the TV...
I think they said it's by some idol that just debuted...

rows.Speaker: Little Airi
rows.Line:
Really...?
She's so cute...!

rows.Speaker: Airi's Mother
rows.Line: Oh, you think so? There's no reason you can't be just as cute as she is, you know.

rows.Speaker: Little Airi
rows.Line:
(Can I really be more like...
An idol?)
A few days later

rows.Speaker: Little Airi
rows.Line:
Hey, she's on a variety show today!
She always looks so cute!

rows.Speaker: Little Airi
rows.Line:
Idols sure are amazing...
Singing, dancing, making all those people smile...

rows.Speaker: Little Airi
rows.Line: They even do all those talk shows! I bet it's a lot of fun!

rows.Speaker: Airi's Sister
rows.Line:
You've been watching this girl a lot lately.
Do you really like her that much?

rows.Speaker: Little Airi
rows.Line: Yeah! It's like just seeing her makes me happy. I can't help but start smiling.

rows.Speaker: Airi's Sister
rows.Line: That means she's just like you!

rows.Speaker: Little Airi
rows.Line: What? Me?

rows.Speaker: Airi's Sister
rows.Line: Yeah! I can't help but start smiling whenever I see you!

rows.Speaker: Little Airi
rows.Line: Really...?

rows.Speaker: Little Airi
rows.Line: Maybe I really can be an idol!

rows.Speaker: Little Airi
rows.Line: I bet I could get up on a big stage like her and sing and dance and make everyone smile!

rows.Speaker: Little Airi
rows.Line:
Alright then...!
I'm going to become an idol!
